name: visio-scientific-illustrator
description: Draw editable scientific figures live inside Microsoft Visio through a local COM bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Draw editable scientific figures live inside Microsoft Visio.
interface.longDescription: Controls only a plugin-owned Microsoft Visio process through a local C# COM bridge. Editable shapes, text, images, glued connectors, groups, containers, styling, movement, and fitting appear step by step in the visible Visio window. The plugin safely saves VSDX files and validates or exports them through an independent hidden file mode.
defaultPrompt: 参考这张图，在可见的 Microsoft Visio 页面中逐步重绘可编辑科研插图。
Recreate this reference figure live in Microsoft Visio, step by step.
